error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the sensor. Check the connection settings and its address on the bus.
error.port_used_by_yaml_hub: The port {link} is held by the modbus setup in configuration.yaml (hub "{hub}"). That setup keeps the port to itself, so this sensor cannot share it: remove it from the YAML entry, or use a different port here.
error.port_held_elsewhere: This port is already open as {held}. Home Assistant tells apart the paths it is given, so the same device under two names looks like two ports. Use {held} here, or in the existing Modbus entry instead of {link}.
error.port_missing: Serial device {link} is not there. Pick the port the sensor is wired to: the list shows the serial ports the system has right now.
error.cannot_open_link: Could not open {link}. Check that it exists, is not busy with another program, and that its settings match. If the same port is also named in a `modbus:` entry in configuration.yaml, remove it there first: a YAML setup holds the port where this check cannot see it.
error.connection_conflict: This sensor is already used with different connection settings. Change those settings on the existing entry instead.

self_check_stuck.title: Presence sensor is stuck in self-check
self_check_stuck.description: Sensor {name} has been reporting a self-check in progress for over a minute. Its measurements stay hidden until it reports that it is running. Power-cycle the sensor; if the code does not change, the device is faulty.

bus_settings_changed.title: Bus settings of {name} were changed
bus_settings_changed.description: The sensor now answers on address {address}, {baudrate} baud, parity {parity}. This entry still uses the old connection settings, so it cannot be reached. Run **Reconfigure** and enter the new values.

device_not_ready.message: The sensor is not ready to accept settings: it reports health code {code}.

zones_do_not_fit.message: The shielding zone and the entry indent add up to {zones} m, which does not fit into a detection range of {detection} m.

value_out_of_range.message: The sensor cannot store this value: {error}

init.title: Bus settings
init.description: Changing the address, speed or parity breaks the link: the sensor starts answering on the new values while this entry keeps the old ones, so its entities become unavailable. To get it back, run **Reconfigure** and enter the new connection settings.

data_description.unit_id: Address of this sensor on the bus, 1 to 247.
data_description.parity: Must match the new setting on the sensor.

bus_settings_confirm.title: Confirm
bus_settings_confirm.description: The sensor stops answering on the current settings as soon as these values are written. You will have to reconfigure the entry to reach it again.
